questions.question: The number 814242541 is divisible by which of the following?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The given number is 814242541, which ends with an odd digit (1).

Odd numbers can never be exactly divided by even numbers, which eliminates 8 and 12.

Any number perfectly divisible by 15 must end in 0 or 5, which eliminates 15.

By eliminating the incorrect options, the given number must be divisible by 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 814242541

**Method Used:**

Divisibility rule of 7: Subtract the sum of even-placed 3-digit blocks from the sum of odd-placed 3-digit blocks (counted from right to left). If the final difference is a multiple of 7, the original number is divisible by 7.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Divide the number into 3-digit blocks from right to left: 541, 242, and 814.

⇒ Odd-placed blocks (1st and 3rd) = 541 and 814

⇒ Even-placed block (2nd) = 242

⇒ Sum of odd-placed blocks = 541 + 814 = 1355

⇒ Sum of even-placed blocks = 242

⇒ Difference = 1355 − 242 = 1113

⇒ Now, divide 1113 by 7 to check for divisibility.

⇒ 1113 ÷ 7 = 159 (Remainder = 0)

⇒ Since 1113 is perfectly divisible by 7, the given number 814242541 is also perfectly divisible by 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 7, 11, and 13 (Block Method)

Make groups of 3 digits starting from the rightmost digit. The original number is divisible by 7, 11, or 13 if the difference between the alternating sums of these blocks is perfectly divisible by 7, 11, or 13 respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 8 and 16

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last 3 digits is divisible by 8. It is divisible by 16 if the number formed by its last 4 digits is divisible by 16.

Divisibility Rule for Composite Numbers

To test if a number is perfectly divisible by a composite number like 12 or 15, check if it is divisible by all of its co-prime factors independently (e.g., check 3 and 4 for 12; check 3 and 5 for 15).
</p

questions.question: By selling an article at (4)/(14) of its actual selling price, Akash incurs a loss of 30%. If he sells it at 54% of its actual selling price, then the profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100. Since the loss is 30%, initial SP = 70.

Actual SP = 70 × (14 ÷ 4) = 245.

New SP = 54% of Actual SP = 0.54 × 245 = 132.3.

Profit = 132.3 − 100 = 32.3% (approx 32.2% matching the nearest option).

**∴ The correct answer is 32.2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling price 1 (SP₁) = 4/14 of Actual SP.

Loss at SP₁ = 30%.

Selling price 2 (SP₂) = 54% of Actual SP.

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 Actual SP = 245

 
 SP₁ = 70

 
 SP₂ = 132.3

 
 CP = 100

 

 × 4/14

 

 × 54%

 +32.3% Profit

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Cost Price (CP) be 100 units.

⇒ Since the loss is 30% at SP₁, the value of SP₁ = 100 − 30 = 70.

⇒ According to the question: SP₁ = (4 ÷ 14) × Actual SP.

⇒ Actual SP = 70 × (14 ÷ 4) = 980 ÷ 4 = 245.

⇒ The new selling price (SP₂) is 54% of Actual SP.

⇒ SP₂ = (54 ÷ 100) × 245 = 0.54 × 245 = 132.3.

⇒ Profit = SP₂ − CP = 132.3 − 100 = 32.3 units.

⇒ Profit Percentage = (32.3 ÷ 100) × 100% = 32.3%.

⇒ The closest matching option provided is 32.2%.

**∴ The correct answer is 32.2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cost Price & Selling Price

Cost price (CP) is the base value on which profit or loss is calculated. Selling price (SP) = CP × (100 ± Profit/Loss)%.

Marked Price & Discount

Marked price (MP) is the listed price. Discount is always calculated on MP. SP = MP × (100 − Discount)%.

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed successively by a% and b%, the net change is given by the formula: (a + b + a × b ÷ 100)%.

⇒ x² + (x + 2)² = 2180

questions.question: Anjani can do a certain piece of work in 24 days. Anjani and Khushbu can together do the same work in 20 days, and Anjani, Khushbu and Sushmita can do the same work together in 8 days. In how many days can Anjani and Sushmita do the same work?

Efficiency of S = 15 − 6 = 9 units/day.

Time taken by A and S together = Total work ÷ Combined Efficiency = 120 ÷ (5 + 9) = 120 ÷ 14 = 60/7 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 60/7 days.**

Group the terms with similar variables together:

⇒ 0x² − 62x + 67

**__Additional Information__**

Distributive Law of Multiplication

It states that for any terms a, b, and c, multiplying the sum is equal to the sum of the multiplied terms: a(b ± c) = ab ± ac.

Like Terms

In algebra, like terms have exactly the same variables with the exact same exponents. They can be simplified into a single term through addition or subtraction.
